comparison.sourcePolicy: Both backends are built and run from the same Klause checkout.
comparison.dependencyPolicy: Refresh normal 0.1.1-SNAPSHOT resolution at campaign start; do not override or pin Koblas artifacts.

interpretation.performance: Report custom-to-HFactor median ratios per trace and over summed production-trace medians.
interpretation.timing: Descriptive on the campaign host; HFactor includes adapter copies and synthetic-prepared timing excludes shadow setup and checkpoint builds.
interpretation.allocations: Java-thread allocation only; HFactor native heap is excluded.
interpretation.scope: Basis factorization, FTRAN, BTRAN, and update replay only; no pricing or whole-LP attribution.
